descriptionByLocale.en:
Senevita is the largest integrated provider of services in old age and employs around 4,300 people. Outpatient and stationary offerings merge seamlessly. While the Senevita locations stand for independent assisted living and comprehensive care, Senevita Casa is the leading provider of private Spitex services throughout Switzerland. For the Senevita Bernerrose in Zollikofen we are looking for a care assistant 50 - 100% Your tasks
• In everyday life you take over the competent basic care according to individual needs
• You comply with the hygiene guidelines and also take on domestic activities
• As a member of the Bernerrose team, you ensure the care and care of the residents with the help of the care concepts
• You lead the care documentation seamlessly and independently You bring that with you
• Completed training Assistant/Health and Social AGS, Certificate Nursing Assistant/SRC or equivalent training
• Experience in a similar position
• Joy in dealing with older people
• Good oral and written knowledge of German (B2) We offer you

• Extensive training offer of the Senevita Academy, which can be visited free of charge

• Discounted food in the in-house gastronomy
